body:
One more remaining piece: removing expired cookies.

Fetch calls "garbage collect cookies" only while processing `Set-Cookie`, and nothing calls "remove expired cookies" otherwise. "Retrieve Cookies" has no expiry condition, because layered-cookies leaves this to Fetch and other callers (its "Requirements Specific to Browser User Agents" lists Remove Expired Cookies as a hook). So if no `Set-Cookie` is processed after a cookie expires, the steps return it:

`m=1; Max-Age=2`, then a request 4 seconds later with no response in between.

Chromium 156, Firefox 157 and WebKit 27.2 do not send it. This was already noted on #1807 ("clearing cookies periodically"), but it is not in the list above.

`cookies/attributes/expired-at-read.html` in web-platform-tests/wpt#64550 covers the request header and `document.cookie` separately, and passes in all three. I found no WPT that waits for expiry.

Drafted with AI help.
